text_en: Alas for those who are at ease in Zion, and for those who feel secure on Mount Samaria, the notables of the first of the nations, to whom the house of Israel resorts!
text_cn: 那些安身熙雍，自恃撒玛黎雅山，自命为诸民之首，为以色列家所归之人，是有祸的！

text_en: Cross over to Calneh, and see; from there go to Hamath the great; then go down to Gath of the Philistines. Are you better than these kingdoms? Or is your territory greater than their territory,
text_cn: 你们去加耳乃观察一下，从那里到大哈玛特，然后下到培肋舍特人的加特，看你们是否比这些国更好？或者你们的疆域比她们的更广大，

text_en: O you that put far away the evil day, and bring near a reign of violence?
text_cn: 那些想避开凶日的，却接近了残暴。

text_en: Alas for those who lie on beds of ivory, and lounge on their couches, and eat lambs from the flock, and calves from the stall;
text_cn: 他们躺在象牙床上，横卧在软榻上，吃着羊群中的羊羔和牛栏中的牛犊，

text_en: who sing idle songs to the sound of the harp, and like David improvise on instruments of music;
text_cn: 伴着琴声吟咏，自比达味，发明乐器，

text_en: who drink wine from bowls, and anoint themselves with the finest oils, but are not grieved over the ruin of Joseph!
text_cn: 大碗喝酒，以上等的油抹身，但对若瑟的崩溃，却漠不关心。

text_en: Therefore they shall now be the first to go into exile, and the revelry of the loungers shall pass away.
text_cn: 为此，这些人现在就要先被掳去；放荡不羁者的狂欢，也就完了。

text_en: The Lord God has sworn by himself (says the Lord , the God of hosts): I abhor the pride of Jacob and hate his strongholds; and I will deliver up the city and all that is in it.
text_cn: 吾主上主指着自己起誓──上主万军的天主的断语──我厌恶雅各伯的骄傲，痛恨他的宫殿；我必将城和城中所有的一切交出。

text_en: If ten people remain in one house, they shall die.
text_cn: 倘若在一家中留下了十个人，也必死尽。

text_en: And if a relative, one who burns the dead, shall take up the body to bring it out of the house, and shall say to someone in the innermost parts of the house, “Is anyone else with you? ” the answer will come, “No. ” Then the relative shall say, “Hush! We must not mention the name of the Lord . ”
text_cn: 幸免的少数亲友，由屋内抬出他们的骨骸，问那内室深处的人说：“还有人同你在一起吗？”他必答说：“没有了。”继而说：“不要做声，千万不要提上主的名字！”

text_en: See, the Lord commands, and the great house shall be shattered to bits, and the little house to pieces.
text_cn: 看，上主一下令，高楼大厦顿成瓦砾，矮小平房荡然无存。

text_en: Do horses run on rocks? Does one plow the sea with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison and the fruit of righteousness into wormwood—
text_cn: 马岂能在悬崖上奔驰，牛岂能在海上耕作？你们竟将公道变为毒药，将正义之果变为苦药！

text_en: you who rejoice in Lo-debar, who say, “Have we not by our own strength taken Karnaim for ourselves? ”
text_cn: 你们为了罗德巴尔而自鸣得意，且说：“我们岂不是靠着自己的力量取得了卡尔纳殷？”

text_en: Indeed, I am raising up against you a nation, O house of Israel, says the Lord , the God of hosts, and they shall oppress you from Lebo-hamath to the Wadi Arabah.
text_cn: 然而，以色列家！看，我必要唤起一个民族来攻打你们，──上主万军的天主的断语──从哈玛特关口蹂躏你们直到阿辣巴河。
